environment.description: Same Rails application deployed on ECS Fargate behind ALB. Split.io SDK initialized with a localhost mode YAML file baked into the container image at build time (split.yaml defines 'archive-extraction-v2' with treatment 'on' for all keys). The SDK operates in localhost/offline mode per Split documentation — it reads treatments from the YAML file and never contacts Split Cloud, making the treatment deterministic and immutable at runtime regardless of dashboard configuration. The SPLIT_API_KEY environment variable is set to 'localhost' which triggers Split SDK's localhost mode. Container image is built in CI with the split.yaml committed to the repository and the image is signed with cosign.

config.container_filesystem: read-only root filesystem with tmpfs on /tmp
